verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes a documented REST API (developers.docusign.com), official SDKs/clients (e.g. Node client), and OpenAPI/Swagger specifications on GitHub explicitly built for both human and machine consumption, satisfying the 'documented public API' story. Community reports include both strong praise for API documentation and successful integrations (docusign-comm-4, docusign-comm-5) and some negative integration/security experiences (docusign-comm-1, docusign-comm-3), but these reflect implementation quality rather than absence of a documented public API. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt endpoint at expected canonical URLs (probes returned 404) and unanimous independent corroboration of API reliability.
